tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: 'gong po ar la gtad pa'i man ngag bzhugs so:

them can bcu gnyis pa/ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rdo rje drag po rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs sgrub bsnyen pa'i rtags rdzogs nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi don byed na: 'gong po ar la gtad par bya: ci phyir bod yul kha ba can: dus mthar 'gong po spun dgus 'khrugs: rje blon 'bangs 'khrugs dpon g.yog gyes: pha spun nang 'khrug gnyen srid 'thor: pha dang bu 'thabs khyim mtshes mkhon: gos dang kha lta yang yang 'gyur: de rnams 'gong pos dbang bsgyur rtags: dus mthar 'gong pos bod khams 'dul: de tshe 'gong po ar gtad 'di: byang sems ldan pas yang yang bya: bstan pa yun du rgyas par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan padma 'byung gnas ngas: 'gong po ar gtad man ngag 'di: phyag na rdo rje dngos la zhus: 'byung po 'dul byed rgyud las bsdus: spre 'u khyi dkar spyang ki yi: thod par 'gong po'i ling ga gzhug: gzugs rnams phal cher mi 'dra la: seng ge stag dang byi la dang: bya dang spre 'u khyi spyang gdong: rnga mo'i gdong pa dag dang mthun: yan lag lcags kyi sgrog tu bcug: snying gar rā tsa tri zhes bri: dpral bar phung byed e zhes bri: srod dang tho rangs dgug gzhug bya: ting 'dzin ting 'dzin zhes bya ba: yid kyis 'dzin phur thebs pa yin: bdag nyid drag po rtsal du bsgom: shar phyogs kha bltas lcags kyus gzung: snang yul rtog pa 'phro mi bya: shes pa rtse gcig dril nas kyang: 'gong po bod kyi shar nas 'byung: shar nas 'gugs 'dren yang yang bya: khug nas phyag rgya bzhi yis bsdam: sngo dmar skud pas liṅga dkri: sngags rgod 'di ni bzla bar bya: sngags 'di yi ge dbu can du 'bri rgyu yin no/ oṃ badzra tsakra e: snying kha rag dunte rbad: phung byed srog la rbad: 'gong po'i dbugs la rngubs: bdud mo'i sha la chems: phung byed 'gong po'i sha rus khrag rtsa la nur nur: ma tsa du a ya sha la na haṃ shaṃ: badzra tri trig:

mā ra ya rbad: badzra nī laṃ dha ra rakṣa: badzra a ri a ri ni: nā ga tsa trig rbad tri: ha ri ha ri: trim trim: phung byed 'gong po'i srog rtsa gtubs gtubs: de lta bu yi drag sngags 'di: rtags dang sbyar la bzlas par bya: rmi lam nang du gang byung ba'i: gzugs de'i sna'i sog sog la: spre 'u'i gzugs kyi snying gar tri: gsal bar bsgoms la sngags 'di brdeg: bod khams 'khrugs shing cho 'phrul che: drag sngags dgu brgya bzlas la brdeg: nang 'khrug cho 'phrul bag re la: brgya rtsa re las mang mi bya: rmi lam cho 'phrul byung ba la: nyi shu gcig las mang mi dgos: tho rangs snga dro dang po la: bdun bdun bzlas pas non 'gyur yin: 'gong po ar la gtad pa'i man ngag rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phyi rabs lnga brgya tha ma la: byang sems ldan pa'i mi gsum gyis: ri mtho'i rtse mor sgrub pa bya: zla ba gcig tu drag sngags bzla: lung pa gsum gyi 'dzoms su gnan: lo rer lan re byas pa na: bod khams bde skyid ldan par 'gyur: gang zag gcig gis zhag bdun du: bsgrubs pas phyogs de khol bur bde: byin rlabs ldan pa'i mi gsum gyis: rgyun du sgrub pa byas gyur na: rtag tu bod la bde skyid 'byung: byang sems ldan pas 'gro don mdzod: las can zhig dang 'phrad par shog: zang zang lha brag nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis bton pa'o// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ shu bhaṃ// 1$0000250༄༅: 'gong po kha sgyur bzhugs so: 1$0000300o rgyan padma bdag gis kyang: phyi rabs don du man ngag 'di: bse sgrom smug po'i nang du sbas: dang po gza' skar thebs rtsis la: kham sa'i rgyu la spre 'u'i gzugs: mi tshad gcig la gos glud bkon: 'bag seng byis pa bya dkar dang: khyi dang dkor glud mang pos bskor: sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas: phyi rol 'bag seng glu gar dang: bro dang rtsed 'jo mang po yis: rgya nag yul du bskyal bar dmigs:

drag sngags ting 'dzin ldan pas bskrad: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ lan chags stong phrin 'jal ba ni: ser sna spongs la sbyin pa gtang: rigs drug lan chags gtor mas sbyang: ri mtho'i rtse la rgyal mtshan gzug: lung gsum mdo ru srog bslu bya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sgrib sbyong man ngag 'di lta ste: dam pa'i chos la 'ur 'don bya: rgyal khrims chos khrims bzang po gzung: sgrib sbyong gzungs la nan tan skyed: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ rigs mthun lha yi man ngag ni: dang po bgegs bskrad lan chags sbyang: sgrib pa sbyangs te dag pa'i lus: rang gi khams dang lha yi mdog: snying po yi ge dang po ni: rang gi ming yig mthun par sbyar: gos rgyan cha lugs thams cad kyang: lha yi sku mdog bzhin du bya: gnas lugs rtogs pa'i skyes bu 'am: the tshom yid gnyis med pa yis: zhag gsum bdun dang bcu bzhi'i bar: rim par bar chad spangs pa yis: 'di sgrub yon tan dpag tu med: sde dpon mnga' thang rgyas pa dang: tshe srog bsring bar the tshom med: lo yi dus su re re bsgrub: las 'phro can gyis nyams su longs: ma hā gu rus bka' bstsal pa: nyon cig mnga' bdag bod kyi rje: nga ni bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku: cir snang rang byung rig pa'i gdangs: thabs dang rten 'brel bsam yas shes: bod kyi sde dpon khrims ldan dang: dge byed chos bzhin byed pa rnams: snyigs ma'i dus su 'di nyid chongs: yon tan drug ldan nor bu'i mdzod: 'di ltar bsgrubs pas ci bsam 'grub: bod khams 'gong pos dbang bsgyur bas: 'gong po kha sgyur man ngag bya 'o: sdug bsngal rnam smin rgyu las byung: tshe rabs snga phyi'i sgrib pa sbyang: sgyu lus bag chags rang gzugs yin: rigs mthun rnam dag lha ru bsgom: ting 'dzin gsal bas nor bu'i mdzod: ci bsam yid kyi 'dzin phur thobs: ma bcos rang grol don gyi mchog: rtag chad gol sa gnyis las 'das: 'di ltar brtson pa'i skyes bu rnams:

tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed: dang po gza' skar bzang po la: dbu btsugs man ngag drug ldan 'di: rim pa bzhin du bsgrub pas ni: bgegs bcom yon tan rgyas par 'gyur: bse sgrom smug po'i nang du sbas: zangs mdzod dmar por rgya yis btab: gnyan chen thang lha gnyer du bskos: ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma la: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: ྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma ya: kha thaṃ: lnga brgya tha ma'i sems can rnams: rang sems skye med rtogs gyur nas: o rgyan padma'i zhal mthong shog: brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i rked nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis bton pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// 1$0000250 ༄༅: 'gong po ar gtad gnan pa'i bskul bzhugs so: 1$0000300o rgyan sprul pa'i sku la 'dud: dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro ba rnams: thugs rje chen pos gzung ba'i phyir: gnas chen byin 'beb man ngag las: 'gong po 'dul gnan cho ga bstan: rang nyid o rgyan seng ge sgra: phyag rdor nyid dang dbyer med bsam: bden stobs mang po brjod cing dgug: 'gong po shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung: shar nas 'gugs 'dren yang yang bya: phyag rgya bzhi spros ting 'dzin spar: dmigs pa'i rten la yang yang bstim: thod par gzhug cing 'di skad brjod: hūm̐: nga ni dug gsum 'joms pa'i sku: dpal ldan sangs rgyas padma skyes: sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku: bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po: nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos: nga ni rgyal ba kun gyi rje: nga ni khro rgyal kun gyi yab: nga ni ma mo kun gyi bdag: nga ni 'byung ba lnga yi dbyings: nga ni srid pa kun gyi mes: nga ni skye 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni bdud 'dul drag po rtsal: khams gsum kun gyi srog gi bdag: skye med 'chi bral rdo rje'i sku: 'gag med rang stong grags pa'i gsung: spros med brjod bral 'gyur med thugs: sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan rdzogs: phrin las lhun grub 'gro ba 'dul:

thogs med sprul pas 'od zer 'gyed: srid pa'i yang srid dam can tshogs: kun kyang sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin: dpal gyi sku la da chum chum: snang srid dregs pa'i lha srin tshogs: kun kyang nga yi bka' 'bangs yin: bka' las ma 'da' dam la 'dus: tha tshig bzhin du gtor ma longs: dam bcas bzhin du phrin las mdzod: phyi rabs bskal pa snyigs ma'i dus: bod khams phung byed 'gong po dgu: sems can rnams kyi bdud du 'bab: de las sprul pa'i dmag rigs dgu: de rnams 'byung ba'i rtags dgu ni: dud 'gro'i mjug spu mgo la 'dogs: 'bangs kyis rgyal la rgol ba'i dus: rgyal khrims nyams byed 'gong po ni: mi lus spre 'u'i mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: ma bu mi gcig gos su gyon: bod 'bangs sil bur 'thor ba'i rtags: sde pa nang 'khrugs 'gong po ni: mi lus seng ge'i mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: phu dung kha mthud dmar po 'dogs: snying rje med pa bshan pa'i rtags: srog gcod nag po'i 'gong po ni: mi lus spyang ki'i mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: mi tshe cho long las la dga': bsod nams dbang thang nyams pa'i rtags: slu byed g.yo sgyu'i 'gong po ni: mi lus zhu me'i mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: mgo la rgya zhu dkar po gyon: rngams sems me ltar 'bar ba'i rtags: tshul chos bdud kyi 'gong po ni: mi lus rnga mo'i mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: gnas dgon thams cad 'thab ra 'cha': bod khams nang 'khrug dar ba'i rtags: khams gsum phung byed 'gong po ni: mi lus khyi yi mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar= mtha' mi'i spyod pa dbus su dar: dmag rigs sde dgu yong ba'i rtags: rgol byed 'khrug pa'i 'gong po ni: mi lus bya yi mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar= seng slog wa yis gyon pa'i dus:

sangs rgyas bstan pa rdzogs pa'i rtags: nag po chom byed 'gong po ni: mi lus stag gi mgo can khyod: khro rgyal 'bar= nyi zla mtha' la spyod pa'i dus: nag po mun 'thibs 'byung ba'i rtags: sdug bsngal nyid 'phel 'gong po ni: mi lus rngams shing khro sems can: khro rgyal 'bar bas 'gugs shing gnon: pha ni dam sri mgo dgu pa: ma ni phung byed nag mo la: bu ni 'gong po spun dgu skyes: cho 'phrul sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'dzam gling 'joms pa'i go gdug can: khyod kyi mthu stobs ma lus nan: gsang bdag padma'i thugs rje yis: nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cig: oṃ laṃ a laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+wambha ya nan: de nas sri gnon byang bu ltar du gnan tshig rnams rgyas par brjod: shu bhaṃ// mi lus sprel gdong*/ seng gdong*/ spyang ki'i gdong*/ zhu me'i gdong*/ rnga mo'i gdong*/ khyi gdong*/ bya'i gdong*/ stag gdong*/ mi gdong*/ mjug ma gdong dang mthun pa yan lag lcags sgrog tu bcug pa'i dpral bar phung byed e zhes pa re bri/ snying gar rā tsa tri zhes pa re re bri'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/// /
